title: GitHub Agentic Workflows Observability Policy
description: Schema for policy rules evaluated against observability-report.json payloads. These rules convert distilled observability signals into enforcement actions such as fail, gate, or warn.

schema_version.description: Version of the observability policy schema.

rules.description: List of policy rules to evaluate against an observability payload.

action.description: Enforcement action to apply when the rule matches.

message.description: Human-readable message explaining the policy violation.

blocked_domains.description: Match if any blocked domain in the payload equals one of these domains.

min_blocked_requests.description: Match if blocked request count is greater than or equal to this threshold.

insight_severities.description: Match if any distilled insight has one of these severities.

actuation_modes.description: Match if the payload actuation mode is one of these values.

mcp_failure_servers.description: Match if any MCP failure references one of these server names.

created_item_types.description: Match if any created item type equals one of these values.
